| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Size** `size` | 30 | 1 to 1000 px | Diameter of the brush. |
| **Hardness** `hardness` | 100 | 0 to 100 % | How sharp the edge of the brush is. Superpixels count as touched where the brush is at least half strength. |
| **Tolerance** `tolerance` | 32 | 0 to 255 | How different in color, texture and edges a neighboring superpixel may be and still join. |
| **Edge sensitivity** `edgeSensitivity` | 50 | 0 to 100 % | How strongly edges between superpixels stop the growth. |
| **Smoothness** `smoothness` | 2 | 0 to 50 px | Radius of the majority smoothing of the selection edge. |
